description: The signed-in couple's own guest list on Zola: change the names, mailing address, email, or phone of up to 25 households, and the events that each household is invited to. Get each guest_group_id, guest_group_version and guest_id from zola_search_my_guests first, and each event_id from zola_list_my_wedding_events. An event change applies to every guest of the household. A new invitation has no RSVP answer and no meal choice. Zola requires the same events for each guest of a household: if its guests are invited to different events, Zola refuses each change of it until the call gives the events that make them the same, and the preview names each guest whose events change. A removal from an event removes the household from that event only: the household stays on the guest list, and the preview says which RSVP answers and meal choices are lost. No tool removes a guest from the guest list: the couple does that on the guest list page of zola.com. Each removed invitation of a guest, and each replaced address, email or phone, counts against a limit of 25 each day for the wedding: a preview with more than 25 is refused, so split a larger change into calls of at most 25 removed invitations, over more than 1 day. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same changes and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Status: preview (nothing changed yet), nothing_to_change (the list already has these values), done (changed), draft_changed or record_changed (the guest list changed, nothing changed: show the new preview and ask again). A call with a used confirm_token returns the stored result. An empty text clears a field. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

changes.description: 1 entry for each household, at most 25

address1.description: The street number and name only, for example 250 Greenwich St. Put an apartment, suite, unit or floor in address2

address2.description: The apartment, suite, unit or floor, for example Apt 4B or Fl 39. Leave it out when the address has none

email.description: An empty text clears the email

guests.description: The name changes of the guests of this household

first_name.description: The new first name. It cannot be empty

last_name.description: The new last name. It cannot be empty

invite_to_event_ids.description: The events to add to the invitations of every guest of this household: each value is an event_id of zola_list_my_wedding_events. The new invitation has no RSVP answer. An event that the household is invited to already does not change

remove_from_event_ids.description: The events to remove from the invitations of every guest of this household: each value is an event_id of zola_list_my_wedding_events. The household stays on the guest list. The RSVP answer, the meal choice and the seat of that event are lost. Never put an event_id in both lists

version.description: guest_group_version from zola_search_my_guests. A change of the group after that read stops the preview

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same changes

name: zola_update_my_guest

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of a change to the guest list of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the guest list

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_update_my_guest with the same changes, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

record_count.description: The guest groups that the change changes

records.description: The guest groups with a change, in the order of the call

event_id.description: For event: the event_id of zola_list_my_wedding_events

field.description: event: an event invitation of 1 guest. The other fields are the names and the contact of the group

from.description: The value before. For event: the name of the event that the guest is removed from. Null for a contact field and for an empty value

hidden.description: True for an address, email, or phone: the values are not given

removal.description: True when the change replaces or clears a value. For event: true for each removed invitation

to.description: The value after. For event: the name of the event that the guest is invited to. Null for a contact field and for an empty value

name.description: The guests of the group, as the couple knows them

version.description: The version of the group as this call read it

removal_count.description: The changes that replace an address, an email, or a phone, and each removed event invitation of a guest

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: the guest list has these values. done: changed. draft_changed and record_changed: nothing changed, a new preview with a new confirm_token

title: Update My Guests
